answer: An admission auction prices bulk fake identities out. Each epoch only 50 identity slots are auctioned; bids set a ferrous floor price, and one deposit cannot back two identities. A newcomer must wander through ten counterparties before earning, so one operator cannot clone one pattern across fakes. Forging 100 identities at 60 credits each costs 6,000, while an honest agent pays 60 once and keeps an undiluted share; winners are set in marble.
